div.div:
· the scroll model moves from a hand-written hook to the registry primitive — the same swap A1 landed on the chief drawer
· the scroll axis flips: column-reverse (scrollTop 0 = newest) → normal scroller (0 = oldest, scrollHeight = newest)
· rows gain real ids: mapTranscript projects m.id onto user / robot / thinking / note / review rows (view-side only, wire untouched)
· useChatFollow and its unit test retire (the detail column was their last consumer)
